result: Any fast method for first-order stationarity (e.g. SVRG) becomes a second-order method by interleaving it with a Hessian-focused step, and the combined rate is set by the slower of the two (Theorem 1); one HessianDescent step gains at least γ³/(24M²).
result_plain: Generic framework: alternate a gradient method with occasional negative-curvature steps.
